base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases

categories.label: Choice category (gas stations & EV charging stations, office supply stores, travel, TV/telecom & wireless, computer services, or business consulting services)

rewards.redemption_notes: 3% and 2% cash back on the first $50,000 in combined choice category/dining purchases each calendar year, 1% thereafter. Redeem cash rewards as a deposit into eligible Bank of America checking or savings account, as a card statement credit, or as a check. Preferred Rewards for Business members earn up to 75% more rewards.

signup_bonus.description: Get a $500 cash rewards bonus after you make at least $5,000 in purchases within 90 days of your account opening.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: Enjoy no annual fee while earning cash back.

benefits.title: Preferred Rewards for Business Bonus
benefits.description: Earn up to 75% more cash back with Preferred Rewards for Business. Platinum Honors members earn up to 5.25% in choice category, 3.5% on dining, and 1.75% on all other purchases on the first $50,000 in combined purchases each calendar year.

benefits.title: Travel and Emergency Services
benefits.description: Travel services include auto rental coverage and $1 million in travel accident insurance, auto rental insurance, emergency ticket replacement, lost luggage assistance and legal and medical referrals when away from home.

benefits.title: Employee Cards at No Additional Cost
benefits.description: Maintain a fleet of cards for your employees at no additional cost with ability to monitor all transactions.

benefits.title: Free Access to Business Credit Scores
benefits.description: View your Dun & Bradstreet business credit scores for free within Business Advantage 360.
